line: All my opps Ben Simmons, they don’t shoot shit (Pussy)
vault_lines: All my opps Ben Simmons, they don't shoot shit (Pussy)
meaning:
Benjamin “Ben” Simmons is a 6'11 point guard for the Brooklyn Nets of the National Basketball Association (NBA).


Simmons is notoriously known for his lack of ability to shoot 3-pointers and mid-range shots.
During his time with the Philadelphia 76ers, Simmons would end his team’s season as he bailed out of a layup against the much smaller Trae Young (6'1) with 7 seconds left in Game 7, which otherwise would’ve allowed them to play against the Milwaukee Bucks in the Eastern Conference Finals.

line: Ask OJ who really gettin’ money
vault_lines: Ask OJ who really gettin' money (Yeah, OJ)
meaning:
This sounds like it could be a reference to basketball player O.J. Mayo. While Mayo was in college at USC, it was reported that he’d received illicit cash and gifts (college players weren’t allowed to receive money or sponsorships at the time), but Mayo himself denied the allegations. So the refrain of “ask OJ who really getting money” could relate to the fact that 21 Lil Harold is actually the one getting the money that was alleged to be in O.J. Mayo’s possession at USC.

vault_lines: Make that ass shake everywhere, Bubba Sparxxx
meaning: Warren Anderson Mathis, better known by his stage name Bubba Sparxxx, is an American rapper. His 2001 single, “Ugly” peaked at number 15 on the Billboard Hot 100 and led him to sign with Timbaland’s Beat Club Records, an imprint of Interscope Records to release his debut studio album, Dark Days, Bright Nights (2001). Met with critical and commercial success, it peaked at number three on the Billboard 200.

This is a reference to his recent single and Chris Brown diss, “Tender.”

line: Rolls paid, feel like Nicolas Cage, I’m a Ghost rider
vault_lines: Rolls paid, feel like Nicolas Cage, I'm a Ghost rider
meaning:
Herb is flaunting a paid off Rolls-Royce Ghost, a large luxury sedan manufactured by Rolls-Royce Motor Cars.



G Herbo and Southside with a Rolls-Royce in 2018

Herbo calls himself a “Ghost rider,” boasting his expensive car, but also mentions how he feels like Nicholas Cage. Cage is an American actor and film producer who portrayed the Marvel Comics superhero Ghost Rider (Johnny Blaze) in the 2007 film of the same name. He also returned for the film’s 2011 sequel and is arguably the actor most synonymous with the character as the first movie is one of his most well-known roles.
